defs.def: better in quality than sb/sth else; greater than sb/sth else （在品质上）更好的；占优势的；更胜一筹的

ex.s: According to the author, a superior doctor is one who       .
ex.t: 根据作者，一位卓越的医生是那种___。

ex.s: REFLECTING fetch superior to calculate have an urge to suspend dismiss explode pace 1 Batteries are not allowed by airlines in checked luggage, as they might due to overheating.
ex.t: 反映取货优势以计算有暂停解除爆炸步伐的冲动1航空公司不允许在托运行李中放置电池，因为它们可能是由于过热造成的。

defs.def: higher in rank, importance or position （在级别、重要性或职位上）更高的

ex.s: I had determined to rise superior to all this, but how is it possible?
ex.t: 我决定要超越这一切，但怎么可能呢？

defs.def: showing by your behaviour that you think you are better than others 有优越感的；高傲的

ex.s: In sci-fi stories, robots often become superior and take over.
ex.t: 在科幻故事中，机器人往往会变得优越并继位。

ex.s: They are much stronger than we are and may be superior to us in the future.
ex.t: 它们比我们强得多，今后可能比我们强。

ex.s: Engaging in competitive sport will help you understand that winning a competition does not make you superior to everyone else and that losing is only a temporary setback, from which you can learn and progress.
ex.t: 参加竞技运动会帮助你理解，赢得比赛并不会让你比其他人优越，而输掉只是暂时的挫折，你可以从中学习和进步。

defs.def: of very good quality; better than other similar things 尤用于广告
a person of higher rank, status or position 级别（或地位、职位）更高的人；上级；上司

ex.s: I. similarity          J. superiors           K. witnessed
ex.t: I. 相似性    J. 上司    K. 目睹
